name: Munch Crunchilicious Cereal
ingredients_raw: Whole wheat flour (Atta)(48.8%), Sugar, Rice Flour (9.6%), Degermed maize (Corn) grits (5.7%), Cocoa Solids (5.5%), Glucose Syrup, Minerals, Palm oil, Nature-Identical Flavouring Substances, Iodized Salt, Vitamins and Antioxidant (307b). Contains Wheat and Sulphite. May contains Milk, Oat, Soy, Barley, Nut, Mustard, Celery, Sesame and Lupin.
